Subject: Your cheque bounce matter

Dear Mr. DSouza,

Thank you for meeting us on 27 April 2026 about your dispute with Shalini Khan. As we understand it, the cheque was dishonoured because the signature did not match.

Our advice is to obtain the bank's certificate on the signature mismatch and treat it as a dishonour under the cheque-bounce law. Please collect the bank's certificate on the signature mismatch and the drawer's earlier cheques and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of 16.1 lakh rupees.

Regards,
Adv. Zubin Contractor
